semiconductor_relevance: High — SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES specializes in advanced thin-film deposition equipment used in various semiconductor applications.
summary: SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES develops and assembles innovative machines for efficient thin-film coating and surface treatment processes, specifically targeting semiconductor applications. Their TIMARIS cluster tools provide a comprehensive range of process modules for precise deposition of ultra-thin films, catering to the needs of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: PVD sputtering systems for ultra-thin film deposition
Cluster tools for magnetic sensors and advanced packaging
